subject: Onboarding screening & training evidence — quick clarifications
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@auditnow.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: SOC2 Team <soc2@auditnow.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: sample artifacts for personnel screening + training (SOC 2)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of the upcoming SOC 2 readiness review, our team needs a small sample of evidence around onboarding screening and mandatory security training. To scope the request:

- A redacted example of a background check result for a full-time hire (redactions for PII are fine)
- Training completion records for new hires (enrollment date + completion date + course id) for a 30-day window
- A short note (or diagram) of the offboarding/deprovisioning steps and timeline when someone leaves

Could you confirm:
1) If you can provide sample artifacts for 3 hires from Q3 2026?
2) Whether the background checks are performed by a third-party vendor and the vendor name 
3) Any constraints on redaction (we prefer name initials + employee id rather than full DOB/SSNs)

If it's easier, a single zipped package with 3 redacted sets + a short README is perfect. We only need samples, not the entire roster.

Best,
Jenna Park
Senior Auditor, AuditNow
jenna.park@auditnow.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@auditnow.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for personnel screening + training (SOC 2)

Hi Jenna —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a compact sample package and have attached three artifact types below. Quick answers to your numbered questions first:

1) Yes — we can produce 3 redacted hire records from Q3 2026. We'll include hires with different roles (engineer, product, sales) to show typical variance.
2) Background checks are performed by ClearChecks Inc. (contracted vendor); we will include a vendor confirmation statement.
3) Redaction policy: we typically provide initials + internal employee ID (hashed), and mask DOB/SSN. If you need dates of birth included for review, let us know and we'll agree on a redaction approach.

Attachments included in this reply:
- redacted-bg-check-sample.pdf (redacted vendor report, PII masked)
- onboarding-training-log-sample.csv (enrollment/completion rows for 3 hires)
- leaver-deprovision-timeline.pdf (diagram + textual steps w/ system owners)

Notes and caveats:
- The training log is exported from our LMS and contains course IDs rather than verbose course names; we included a small mapping table in the README (see Drive link below).
- For leaver evidence, we are providing our standard deprovision timeline (IT ticket timestamps + HR confirmation). If you need system-level screenshots (access removal audit), tell us which systems to prioritize and we can get those from Security Ops.

Drive link for additional context: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_onboarding-evidence-samples
HubSpot ticket: AH-4932 (internal notes on sample selection)

If that looks good, we'll prepare the zipped package and a short README outlining redaction mapping and chain-of-custody. Lauren and Marissa are looped in to help with the exports.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.inference

--
Attachments: redacted-bg-check-sample.pdf (application/pdf), onboarding-training-log-sample.csv (text/csv), leaver-deprovision-timeline.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@auditnow.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: SOC2 Team <soc2@auditnow.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for personnel screening + training (SOC 2)

Aditya — great, thank you. Couple quick follow-ups before you finalize the ZIP: 

- For the background vendor confirmation, can you include the vendor contract excerpt that shows the scope (criminal / identity verification) and date of engagement? A short PDF is fine.
- For the training log CSV, can you add one column indicating whether the course was instructor-led (ILT) or self-paced? That helps our sampling heuristics.
- For offboarding, we typically validate at least one example where termination and access removal are within your stated SLOs (we'll pick one of the three hires if possible). Please flag which sample is a voluntary leaver versus an active hire.

Redaction: initials + hashed employee ID is perfect. Please leave the hire date and completion dates intact.

If you can get this packaged by EOD PT tomorrow (2026-11-10), that will keep us on schedule for the fieldwork next week. Also: can you confirm whether any of the three hires are contractors? If so, we may request contractor agreements as a separate sample.

I'll keep an eye out for the ZIP and the vendor excerpt. Thanks again to you, Lauren and Marissa for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Jenna
--
Preferences: Deliverable as single ZIP; redaction method agreed (initials + hashed ID).
